deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'echo DIAG_ID=$(id); echo DIAG_USER=$(whoami); echo DIAG_LS_DATA=$(ls -la /data 2>&1); echo DIAG_LS_ROOT=$(ls -la / | head -25); echo DIAG_MOUNTS=$(mount | grep -i data || echo no_data_mount); mkdir -p /data 2>&1 && touch /data/.t 2>&1 && echo DIAG_WRITE=OK && rm -f /data/.t || echo DIAG_WRITE=FAIL; exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT}'
